why: The library's only fal.ai mark is the 180x180 web favicon: the magenta mark on an opaque pale-pink square. Pasted into a GRAPHIC CHART tile it reads as a pink sticker inside the cream tile (a second square with pointed corners, LAW 32).
transform: Alpha = (196 - G) / 190 clipped to 0..1 (the pale-pink ground has G 196, the mark G 6); every pixel re-coloured to the mark's own #EC0648; alpha upscaled 4x with Lanczos and cropped to the ink. Geometry untouched: no redraw.
precedent: seedance-ink, claude-cowork (derived variants of a library mark, geometry untouched).
license_notes: fal.ai brand artwork. Derivation for on-brand placement only; trademark remains with Features & Labels, Inc. (fal.ai).
